assumptions: The stated 3.3 V logic voltage and 4.7 kΩ pull-up value are used for arithmetic only.
Each pull-up current is calculated as 3.3 V / 4.7 kΩ = 0.702 mA.
The combined worst-case static current for two pull-ups is 1.404 mA.
Pull-up resistor dissipation is calculated as 3.3 V^2 / 4.7 kΩ = 2.32 mW per resistor, but resistor power rating is unspecified, so no rating verdict is issued.
No LED, divider, regulator, decoupling, or resistor footprints/components are present in the supplied MVP context.
